faqs.question: What is a status page?
faqs.answer: A status page is a public-facing webpage that displays the current operational status of your services, systems, and applications. It helps keep your users informed about any ongoing issues or maintenance.

faqs.question: How quickly can I set up a status page?
faqs.answer: You can have a basic status page up and running in under 5 minutes. Simply sign up, add your services, and customize your page to match your brand.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom domains?
faqs.answer: Yes! Pro and Enterprise plans include custom domain support, allowing you to host your status page on your own domain (e.g., status.yourcompany.com).

faqs.question: What happens if your service goes down?
faqs.answer: We have a 99.9% uptime SLA and use multiple monitoring systems to ensure our service remains available. In the rare event of an issue, we communicate transparently through our own status page.

faqs.question: Can I integrate with my existing tools?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We offer integrations with popular tools like Slack, PagerDuty, Datadog, and many others. Our API also allows for custom integrations.
